{{Top|leg}}
'''The First To Swim''' was the title given to the leader of [[the School]], the loose government that oversaw [[Iskalonian]] society. For many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the School had not required a formal leader, but established the role by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to align with the truism "someone must ever be the first to swim." The First To Swim would lead the Iskalonians, and the others would follow. The [[Inleshat/Legends|Inleshat]] [[Primor (Inleshat)|Primor]] served as The First To Swim during their negotiations with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and the Iskalonians followed him because he refused to take his people against their own inclinations. Primor served as The First To Swim until his [[Death/Legends|death]], being succeeded by his own son, [[Mone]].<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
